name: MiniCPM5-2B-Claude-Fable5-1-Thinking-Agentic
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, 16 query heads and 2 kv heads
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 2.517 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-21. CAVEATS: two rows, both on ClawBench, an agentic-coding harness whose items and scoring the card does not describe; shots, temperature and judge are unstated. The base column is labelled 'MiniCPM5-2B (Base, RL-only)' while the base's own card describes it as RL+OPD. Margins are +2.45 and +1.13 points, a single run each. BFCL/SWE-bench/tau2 promised, not published.
